Comment: IS459 Group 7 BQ1 pipeline: ingest/clean -> risk scoring -> refresh catalog -> capacity curve query. Replace <BUCKET> before creating.

Parameters.QueryString: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(is_laundering_account) AS total_laundering FROM is459_aml.account_day_scores), limits AS (SELECT n FROM (VALUES 25, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000) AS t(n)) SELECT l.n AS daily_limit, SUM(s.is_laundering_account) AS laundering_caught, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.is_laundering_account) / MAX(t.total_laundering), 1) AS recall_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.is_laundering_account) / COUNT(*), 2) AS precision_pct FROM limits l JOIN is459_aml.account_day_scores s ON s.daily_rank <= l.n CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY l.n ORDER BY l.n
